scope: All 36 pets in the Classic expansion tab, Retail only.
selectionPolicy: Search all retrieved parent comments and complete reply lists for profit first. Prefer a highly rated numbered acquisition guide ending in profit; remove its final step. Otherwise synthesize original numbered instructions from acquisition comments, replies and current Retail database source records. Rating is the available preference signal; green CSS styling was not independently verified.
researchLimit: Full public comment arrays and every reported reply were retrieved for the recorded pages. All profit candidates were considered before fallback acquisition comments. Ordinary public AJAX requests expanded missing replies. Receipts identify the pages retrieved, not every guide ever linked from Wowhead. Dungeon pins identify surface approaches; interior navigation is given as text where current Retail floor coordinates were not verified. No in-game acquisition was performed.

guides.name: Mechanical Squirrel
guides.source: Engineering: Mechanical Squirrel Box
steps: Choose whether to craft or buy. Non-engineers can buy a finished Mechanical Squirrel Box or ask an engineer to make one.
To craft it yourself, train Classic Engineering with Lilliam Sparkspindle in Stormwind (62.8, 32.0) or Nogg in Orgrimmar (56.6, 56.4). Raise Classic Engineering to 75 to learn the schematic.
Acquire Schematic: Mechanical Squirrel (4408), a low-level world-drop recipe also sold by players. Learn the recipe before buying materials.
Bring 1 Handful of Copper Bolts, 1 Copper Bar and 2 Malachite. Craft Mechanical Squirrel Box with the learned recipe.
Use Mechanical Squirrel Box from your bags to learn Mechanical Squirrel, then check the Pet Journal. The learned pet is shared across your account.
guides.tips: The schematic and the finished box are different items. Engineering is required to craft, but not to learn the finished pet.
guides.requirements: Classic Engineering 75 to learn the recipe; no profession required to learn the pet.
guides.cost: 1 Handful of Copper Bolts, 1 Copper Bar, 2 Malachite; recipe/player prices vary.

guides.name: Jubling
guides.source: Spawn of Jubjub at the Darkmoon Faire
steps: Prepare at least 2 Dark Iron Ale Mugs, preferably spares. Buy from the Auction House or Plugger Spazzring in the Grim Guzzler inside normal Blackrock Depths. Approach Blackrock Mountain near 21.0, 38.0 in Burning Steppes; use the central rock and lower chain route to BRD.

For the dungeon purchase, reach the Grim Guzzler before making its patrons hostile and buy the ales from Plugger. Direbrew's Remote, if you own one, gives a direct trip. Keep one mug unused for the quest turn-in.

During the Darkmoon Faire, find Morja near 55.6, 70.6 on Darkmoon Island. If she already offers Spawn of Jubjub, skip the bait and hand in an ale. Otherwise dismiss your own Jubling or other pets that can drink the bait.

When Jubjub is nearby, use a Dark Iron Ale Mug from your bags and place its ground target at Morja's feet. Wait for the frog to reach it. Her call is a timing cue, not a required unlock. Do not discard or drink the mug.
If Jubjub stays out of range, find him behind Morja and place spare mugs as a short trail toward her, ending at her feet. Let him reach the bait before placing the next mug.
When Morja offers Spawn of Jubjub (7946), accept and hand in another Dark Iron Ale Mug. Collect the Unhatched Jubling Egg reward.
Wait 7 real days for the egg to mature, open it for A Jubling's Tiny Home, then use that item to learn Jubling. The wait continues while you are offline.
